title: Can a Normal Person Afford a Corvette ZR1?
description:
The new Corvette ZR1 starts at one hundred seventy-four thousand, nine hundred ninety-five dollars. That is about three and a half times the average price of a new car in America today. A published five-year cost-to-own estimate puts the total at more than one hundred seventy-four thousand dollars on top of the purchase. So, can a normal person afford a Corvette ZR1? We ran the numbers. We will use the official prices, the option list, a published five-year ownership estimate, dealer markup reports, and the Census Bureau's median household income. We will do simple arithmetic and label it as ours. We will not guess at your finances, and we will not give financial advice, because we do not know your situation. Every figure comes from a published source, listed in the description.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
